summary: Tested new endpoints POST /api/fund-calls/regenerate-entries and POST /api/fund-calls/delete-all, plus the FundCallsPage UI buttons. 10/10 backend pytest tests passed (chinese-wall enforcement, regenerate with correct VE description prefixes per call_type, delete-all + cleanup of auto journal entries, Demo ACP integrity). Frontend verified: both buttons present with correct data-testid, regenerate flow works end-to-end ('6/6 ecriture(s) comptable(s) regeneree(s) avec libelle correct.' toast), call-type badges render correctly (Provisions, Fonds de roulement, Fonds de reserve). No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: fund_calls.py delete-all/regenerate-entries: chinese-wall correctly enforced (rejects missing and 'all' values, header fallback supported).
auto_entries.py L298: _delete_auto_entries is called inside generate_sale_entry before insert, so regenerate is idempotent (no duplicate VE entries). Confirmed via repeated calls.
Frontend FundCallsPage uses window.confirm before destructive ops; both buttons are conditionally rendered only when calls.length > 0 (correct).

Minor: regenerate-entries endpoint counts as 'regenerated' only when generate_sale_entry returns a non-null entry (e.g., for a call with 0 lines it would silently skip). Acceptable since errors[] is also returned.

Minor consistency: legacy endpoint POST /fund-calls/{id}/generate-entries still uses old static description 'Appel de fonds: {name}' (journal_type AP, not VE). Different from the auto-VE flow but kept for back-compat.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 TEST_iter29_* fund calls (one per call_type) on ACP Test (252c2888-...) - all cleaned up via delete-all in same test class. ACP Demo (6748ca1a-...) preserved with its 6 calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ACP Demo VE entries now have correct prefixes (Appel de provisions / Appel fonds de reserve / Appel fonds de roulement). ACP Test ends up empty after the suite (delete-all clears it). If you need to regenerate VE entries again, hit POST /api/fund-calls/regenerate-entries?copropriete_id={id}.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature works as designed; no bug to fix.
